description: This script automates the process of fetching, parsing, and updating a README file with manifest data from a remote XML source, including generating comparison tables for different release tags.

methods.name: fetch_manifest_xml
methods.description: Fetches manifest XML content from a remote URL based on manifest name and release tag.

methods.name: parse_manifest
methods.description: Parses the XML content to extract Yocto version and project revisions.

methods.name: generate_table_single
methods.description: Generates a markdown table listing layers and their revisions.

methods.name: generate_table_compare
methods.description: Generates a markdown comparison table between two sets of layer revisions.
